Incident_Description: Worker slipped on wet floor near crystallization tank. No spill containment mat was in place. Minor bruise on left arm.
Technician handling concentrated acid without proper gloves. Burn on right hand. Emergency shower used immediately.
Loose bolt fell from overhead conveyor structure during maintenance. Hit worker's hard hat. No injury but near-miss classified as incident.
Spilled potash granules on floor caused worker to slip. Twisted ankle. Area was not cleaned after previous shift.
Loader operator collapsed due to heat exposure. Temperature was 42C. Water station was 200m away. Transported to clinic.
Operator's sleeve caught in crusher feed mechanism. Machine was not properly locked out. Arm laceration requiring stitches.
Three workers reported dizziness near brine evaporation pools. Ventilation system had failed 2 hours prior. No alarm triggered.
Water leak from pipe joint created puddle near walkway. Worker slipped carrying tools. Minor back strain.
Dump truck rear-ended water tanker on haul road. Driver was speeding in construction zone. Both vehicles damaged. Driver bruised ribs.
Two workers fainted during routine inspection of solar evaporation ponds. Midday temperature exceeded 45C. Rest breaks were not enforced.
Electrician received shock while inspecting motor control panel. Ground fault protection had been bypassed during previous repair.
Condensation buildup on metal stairs near crystallization unit. Worker slipped descending stairs. Bruised knee.
Splash of diluted acid during transfer operation. Worker was not wearing face shield. Minor burn on cheek.
Small rocks fell from conveyor belt onto worker below. Hard hat prevented injury. Belt alignment was off causing material spillage.
Worker strained lower back lifting 40kg bag without mechanical assistance. Lift assist equipment was available but not used.
Cleaning water overflow from tank washing created slippery surface. Worker slipped. Minor wrist sprain.
Forklift collided with parked trailer in poorly lit area. Night shift lighting had two burned out fixtures. Forklift operator whiplash.
Worker opened valve in wrong sequence during brine transfer. Small chemical splash. Quick response prevented serious exposure.
Ice formation on outdoor walkway between buildings during winter morning. Worker slipped. Bruised hip.
Packaging machine guard had been removed for cleaning and not replaced. Worker's hand contacted moving belt. Finger laceration.
Early season heat wave. Worker reported dizziness. Sent to rest area. Mild dehydration.
Night shift worker handling acid without full PPE. Splash on forearm. Training records showed expired safety certification.
Rock fragment ejected from crusher. Hit worker standing outside exclusion zone. The exclusion zone barriers had been moved.
Salt crust on walkway near solar ponds. Worker slipped during routine monitoring. Minor scrape.
Maintenance worker contacted live terminal in motor starter. Energy isolation procedure was not followed completely.
Repetitive lifting of product bags without rotation breaks. Worker reported chronic shoulder pain after shift.
Worker collapsed during summer inspection. Core body temperature elevated. Required medical evacuation. Shade structures inadequate.
Overflow from wash cycle. Water pooled near equipment base. Worker slipped while checking gauges.
Gasket failure on brine transfer line. Workers in area exposed to mist. Two reported throat irritation. Line was not inspected per schedule.
Haul truck brake failure on downhill grade. Truck slid into safety berm. Driver shaken but uninjured. Brake inspection was overdue by 2 weeks.
Persistent moisture issue near cooling tower outlet. Third slip in this location this year. No permanent fix implemented.
Inspection panel blown open by wind. Hit passing worker. Panel fasteners were corroded and not replaced during last maintenance.
Worker used wrong container for acid transfer. Container material reacted with acid. Splash during reaction. Arm burn.
Crusher started during maintenance. Lockout tag had been removed by another worker who thought maintenance was complete. Near miss - worker jumped clear.
Late season heat event. Worker felt nauseous after 3 hours in sun. Water breaks had been skipped due to loading deadline.
Product spillage on polished floor. No immediate cleanup. Worker slipped carrying clipboard. Minor elbow bruise.
Apprentice attempted to work on energized circuit without supervision. Minor shock to fingers. Training gap identified.
Worker attempted to lift two bags simultaneously to save time. Strained lower back. Second incident for this worker.
Morning condensation on metal grating. Worker slipped during shift handover walk. Bruised shin.
Ventilation unit tripped on power fluctuation. Not restarted for 4 hours. Night shift workers complained of headaches.
Driver using mobile phone while operating light vehicle. Rear-ended stationary equipment. Minor neck strain. Phone policy violated.
Dust cover dislodged from crusher hood. Fell on walkway near worker. Hard hat area but worker was adjusting hat at time.
Mud buildup on access path after rain. Worker slipped during morning inspection. Knee scrape.
First major heat wave of season. Three workers reported to clinic. Work-rest cycle was not adjusted for temperature increase.
Worker removed gloves to operate phone. Residual acid on hands caused delayed burn reaction. Discovered after shift.
Conveyor guard removed for jam clearance. Worker reached in while belt was moving. Finger tip contusion. Guard interlock was disabled.
Same location as multiple previous incidents near cooling tower outlet. New slip reported. No engineering control implemented despite repeated incidents.
Peak summer. Two workers required IV fluids. Solar pond inspection route has no shade for 800m. Buddy system not enforced.
Pump seal failure sprayed brine mixture. Worker drenched. Emergency shower activated. Pump seal replacement was scheduled but delayed.
Night shift worker slipped on condensation. This is the fourth year of repeated slips at this location during summer months.
Speeding water tanker on curve. Rolled onto side. Driver wore seatbelt. Minor injuries. Speed monitoring system was not operational.
Material falling from transfer point between conveyors. Worker in area without authorization. Exclusion zone signage faded.
Major shock event during panel inspection. Worker hospitalized overnight. Wiring had been modified without documentation during previous shutdown.
End of shift fatigue. Worker dropped bag on foot while lifting. Steel toe boot prevented serious injury. Fatigue management policy not followed.
Post-maintenance washdown water not drained. Morning shift encountered puddles. Worker slipped. Communication gap between shifts.
Incorrect dilution ratio used during acid preparation. Stronger-than-expected solution splashed during mixing. Hand burn.
Plastic wrapping material on floor near packaging line. Worker stepped on it and slid. Minor ankle twist.
Unseasonably warm January day. Worker not acclimated. Reported dizziness. Sent home early.
Third ventilation failure incident in 2 years. Backup system also failed. Multiple workers evacuated. Root cause: aged ventilation equipment.
Haul truck struck maintenance vehicle parked without reflectors at night. Significant vehicle damage. Two workers minor injuries.
Similar to 2022 incident. Lockout procedure not followed during component replacement. Worker narrowly avoided rotating parts.
Annual spring cleaning created excess water. Same crystallization area. Worker slipped. Recurring problem.
Wind-loosened panel struck worker. Third panel incident at conveyors. Panel securing system needs redesign.
Early summer heat. Workers did not take mandated water breaks. Supervisor was absent. Two workers treated for dehydration.
Worker handling acid with torn gloves. Did not report damaged PPE. Acid penetrated glove and burned fingers.
Cooling tower condensation. Same recurring location. Worker slipped. Fifth year of incidents at this exact spot.
Worker performed 6 hours of lifting without rotation. Back pain reported next day. Rotation schedule exists but not enforced at night.
Worker tested circuit without proper lockout verification. Minor shock. Supervisor was not present for high-risk work.
Peak summer. Shade structure still not built despite 3 years of similar incidents. Worker collapsed. Medical evacuation required.
Corroded flange failure on brine line. Night shift detected by smell. Evacuation completed. Flange was flagged for replacement 6 months prior.
Oil spill from conveyor gearbox not cleaned. Worker slipped. Oil absorbent materials were not stocked in the area.
Driver adjusting radio while driving. Swerved off haul road. Vehicle damage. No injuries due to low speed.
Recurring issue: guards removed during jam clearance and not replaced. Night shift worker contacted moving parts. Finger injury.
Rock fragment ejected. Worker within exclusion zone. Hard hat and safety glasses prevented injury.
New employee performed acid transfer without buddy. Splash on leg. Training completion not verified before assignment.
Winter condensation and wet floor near crystallization. Same area. Slip and fall. Annual recurring pattern now clearly documented.
Mild winter heat event. Worker not feeling well due to dehydration. Sent to rest area.
Worker injured back lifting heavy replacement parts without crane. Crane was available 50m away. Time pressure from supervisor.
Fourth ventilation incident. New ventilation system procurement approved but not yet installed. Workers evacuated.
Same recurring location. Worker slipped on wet grating. This location has had 15+ slip incidents over 5 years.
Speeding dump truck failed to stop at intersection. T-bone collision with utility vehicle. Two workers hospitalized.
Insulation breakdown in aged motor. Worker contacted exposed conductor during inspection. Shock to hand.
Panel incident again. Same conveyor section. Management approved redesign after this incident.
Pre-summer heat. Solar pond workers without adequate hydration plan. Two treated. Shade structures still under construction.
Night shift worker improvised PPE due to shortage. Acid splash on exposed forearm. PPE inventory management gap.
Third lockout-related incident at crusher. New electronic lockout system installation expedited after this event.
Peak summer condensation. Same location. Anti-slip coating project finally approved and scheduled for next shutdown.
Peak summer. Despite new protocols
column8: enforcement was lax. Worker collapsed. Shade structure 60% complete.

Incident_Description: New ventilation system experienced commissioning issues. Brief exposure event. Resolved within 30 minutes.
Brake system warning ignored by driver. Near-miss at intersection. Vehicle inspection adherence at 78% compliance.
Worker skipped using lift assist equipment. Back strain. Equipment was functioning and available.
Post-shutdown restart created temporary wet conditions. Worker slipped. Anti-slip coating installed on 3 of 5 areas.
Minor rock fragment. Worker wearing full PPE. No injury. New crusher guards working as designed.
Minor acid splash. Worker wearing proper PPE. New face shield deflected splash effectively. PPE policy enforcement improved.
Worker felt tingling but new safety gloves prevented shock. Near-miss. Electronic lockout system flagged unauthorized access attempt.
Reduced incidents after anti-slip coating. Minor slip on untreated area. Full coating completion scheduled for Q1 2026.
